description: Health and activity of the Bitsocial peer-to-peer network.

options.content:
Network overview  ·  5chan boards  ·  Seedit communities

Live health and activity of the Bitsocial peer-to-peer network, measured continuously by the Bitsocial stats monitor.

panels.description: Bitsocial websites plus the newsletter, spam blocker and challenge servers that respond as expected right now.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_success)) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_success))

panels.title: Services up

panels.description: 5chan and Seedit communities whose latest fetch succeeded and whose latest update is less than 2 hours old.

targets.expr: sum(((max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_seconds_since_updated_at{client_id=~"5chan|seedit"}) < bool 7200) * max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id=~"5chan|seedit"})) or (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id=~"5chan|seedit"}) * 0))

panels.title: Communities online

panels.description: All-time posts and replies across the default 5chan and Seedit communities, counted like the 5chan homepage.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id=~"5chan|seedit"})) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id=~"5chan|seedit"}))

panels.title: Total posts

panels.description: Addresses that posted in the last 7 days across the default 5chan and Seedit communities, counted like the 5chan homepage: summed per community, so an address active in several communities counts once for each.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_week_active_user_count{client_id=~"5chan|seedit"}))

panels.title: Current users

panels.description: Posts and replies from the last 24 hours in communities the monitor can currently fetch, stacked per client.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_post_count{client_id="5chan"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) == 1)) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_reply_count{client_id="5chan"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="5chan"}) == 1))

sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_post_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1)) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_day_reply_count{client_id="seedit"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_last_community_update_fetch_success{client_id="seedit"}) == 1))

panels.title: Posts (24h)

panels.description: Addresses that posted in the last 7 days, summed per community like the 5chan homepage, stacked per client.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_week_active_user_count{client_id="5chan"}))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_week_active_user_count{client_id="seedit"}))

panels.title: Current users

panels.description: All-time posts and replies, stacked per client.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id="5chan"})) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id="5chan"}))

sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_post_count{client_id="seedit"})) + sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_community_stats_all_reply_count{client_id="seedit"}))

panels.title: Total posts

panels.description: Approximate city-level locations of peers that provide community IPNS records through HTTP routers, derived from their public IP addresses. Larger dots mean more peers in that city.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_ipns_http_routers_peer_location_count)

panels.title: Where peers are

panels.description: Unique peers across all monitored communities: peers connected to community pubsub topics, and peers that HTTP routers list as providers of community pubsub topics and IPNS records.

targets.expr: sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_pubsub_peer_count))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_pubsub_http_routers_peer_count))
sum(max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_network_ipns_http_routers_peer_count))

panels.title: Peers over time

panels.description: Green while a website or service answers with the expected status and content; red while its check fails.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_success)
max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_success)

panels.title: Bitsocial services

panels.description: What 5chan and Seedit use by default in pure P2P mode: HTTP routers to find peers, and Ethereum RPCs to resolve community names. A router is green while it answers provider lookups for monitored communities; an RPC is green while it resolves a test name.

targets.expr: max by (http_router_url) (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"}))

max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_success{chain_provider_url=~"https://ethereum-rpc\\.publicnode\\.com|https://eth\\.drpc\\.org|https://ethereum\\.publicnode\\.com|https://rpc\\.mevblocker\\.io|https://1rpc\\.io/eth|https://eth-pokt\\.nodies\\.app|ethers\\.js",chain_ticker="eth"})

panels.title: Client infrastructure

panels.description: How long each successful website and service check took.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_duration_seconds) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_webpage_last_webpage_fetch_success) == 1)

max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_duration_seconds) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_service_probe_last_success) == 1)

panels.title: Bitsocial services

panels.description: Average time for each HTTP router to answer the latest successful provider lookup for each community. Gaps mean every lookup failed.

targets.expr: avg by (http_router_url) (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_duration_seconds{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"}) == 1))

panels.title: HTTP router lookup time

panels.description: Share of monitored communities for which each HTTP router returned at least one IPNS record provider on its latest lookup. Failed lookups count as not found.

targets.expr: (count by (http_router_url) ((max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_provider_count{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"}) > 0) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"}) == 1)) or count by (http_router_url) (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"})) * 0) / count by (http_router_url) (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_http_router_last_community_ipns_get_providers_fetch_success{http_router_url=~"https://peers\\.pleb\\.bot|https://routing\\.lol|https://peers\\.forumindex\\.com|https://peers\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://routerofbitsocial\\.xyz|https://bsotracker\\.online"}))

panels.title: Communities found by each router

panels.description: Time for each Ethereum RPC to resolve a test name. Gaps mean the resolution failed.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_duration_seconds{chain_provider_url=~"https://ethereum-rpc\\.publicnode\\.com|https://eth\\.drpc\\.org|https://ethereum\\.publicnode\\.com|https://rpc\\.mevblocker\\.io|https://1rpc\\.io/eth|https://eth-pokt\\.nodies\\.app|ethers\\.js",chain_ticker="eth"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_chain_provider_last_resolve_address_success{chain_provider_url=~"https://ethereum-rpc\\.publicnode\\.com|https://eth\\.drpc\\.org|https://ethereum\\.publicnode\\.com|https://rpc\\.mevblocker\\.io|https://1rpc\\.io/eth|https://eth-pokt\\.nodies\\.app|ethers\\.js",chain_ticker="eth"}) == 1)

panels.title: Name resolution time

panels.description: IPFS gateways and pubsub providers that 5chan and Seedit only use when pure P2P mode is turned off. Green while the provider passed its latest check.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_success{ipfs_gateway_url=~"https://ipfsgateway\\.xyz|https://gateway\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://gateway\\.forumindex\\.com"})

min by (pubsub_provider_url) ({__name__=~"bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_(publish|subscribe)_success",pubsub_provider_url=~"https://pubsubprovider\\.xyz/api/v0|https://plebpubsub\\.xyz/api/v0|https://rannithepleb\\.com/api/v0"})

panels.title: Gateway mode providers

panels.description: Time to fetch a comment through each gateway. Gaps mean the fetch failed.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_duration_seconds{ipfs_gateway_url=~"https://ipfsgateway\\.xyz|https://gateway\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://gateway\\.forumindex\\.com"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_ipfs_gateway_last_comment_fetch_success{ipfs_gateway_url=~"https://ipfsgateway\\.xyz|https://gateway\\.plebpubsub\\.xyz|https://gateway\\.forumindex\\.com"}) == 1)

panels.title: Gateway comment fetch time

panels.description: Time for each pubsub provider to publish a test message. Gaps mean the check failed.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_publish_duration_seconds{pubsub_provider_url=~"https://pubsubprovider\\.xyz/api/v0|https://plebpubsub\\.xyz/api/v0|https://rannithepleb\\.com/api/v0"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_publish_success{pubsub_provider_url=~"https://pubsubprovider\\.xyz/api/v0|https://plebpubsub\\.xyz/api/v0|https://rannithepleb\\.com/api/v0"}) == 1)

panels.title: Pubsub publish time

panels.description: Time for each pubsub provider to subscribe a test message. Gaps mean the check failed.

targets.expr: max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_subscribe_duration_seconds{pubsub_provider_url=~"https://pubsubprovider\\.xyz/api/v0|https://plebpubsub\\.xyz/api/v0|https://rannithepleb\\.com/api/v0"}) and (max without(instance, job, service, subplebbit_address) (bitsocial_stats_pubsub_provider_last_subscribe_success{pubsub_provider_url=~"https://pubsubprovider\\.xyz/api/v0|https://plebpubsub\\.xyz/api/v0|https://rannithepleb\\.com/api/v0"}) == 1)

panels.title: Pubsub subscribe time
